_what: Words the arrangement says about its own saving (tools/screen-arrangement/show/screen-arrangement-context.tsx). `stale` is shown when a drag was made from an older copy of an arrangement kept elsewhere since: nothing was replaced, and the screen now shows what is kept. `seconds_shown` is how long it stays.
stale: This screen was arranged somewhere else, so your change was not kept. It now shows the arrangement kept there.
at_minimum: Pane reached its minimum {axis} of {minimum} pixels.
size: Pane {axis} {size} pixels. Use the arrow keys to resize this pane only; Home moves to its minimum.
